item.description:
Source91Mobiles Series
LanguageHindi
CategoryWeb Series
Release Date20 Nov 2026

Teen Tigada is a youthful coming-of-age drama that follows Asmani and Manas, two ambitious young dreamers trying to balance love, friendship, and their personal aspirations in Mumbai. As they chase their goals in music and cricket, an unexpected twist turns their carefree lives upside down, forcing them to confront responsibilities they never saw coming.
